comments.comment: All lives are important for the same reason. Every body has worth and purpose. The Holy Spirit is the giver of Life.

I’ve thought about this so much! I used to volunteer, I was trained as a sidewalk advocate. I grew up in prcs but after becoming a foster parent I couldn’t look away from everything else. I still consider myself prolife but no longer believe that the prolife movement is how we protect life. It’s so much more than that.

This is so important. We need to be pro-life for all lives, from preborn children to those targeted by ICE to the people of Gaza—all lives, all precious. I hold to the consistent life ethic, and there are many pro-life groups and people out there that value life at all stages. Shoutout to my friends at @rehumanizeintl and @feministschoosinglife especially

The Christian pro-life movement starts with the belief that every human being is made in God’s image as valuable, loved, and worthy of life.

That’s why it focuses on specifically protecting the unborn and their right to not have their lives taken unjustly.

But to your point, Dawn, as Christians we’re called to love people well and to speak up for those who can’t speak for themselves. We need to care about people who are suffering, struggling, or in need and it’s not one or the other 🩷
Yes I feel this 100%! Thank you for this ❤️
I can totally relate. Your story is my story, too.

There is a huge difference in being pro life and pro birth. Voting to keep children from having food, housing and heathcare isn’t pro life. Unaffordable childcare isn’t pro life. Limited family leave isn’t pro life. Moms dying or being unable to have children because they couldn’t have a life saving medical procedure isn’t pro life.
Yes. Because they are *pro-birth* not pro-life. And you can tell that's the case because they want women to have babies, but they don't want to do anything to help or support after the baby is born.

I have been involved in the pro-life community for over 20 years and yes abortion is emphasized most, but it is almost always followed by a phrase such as "prolife means from the womb to tomb" or "prolife means caring about life at all stages". I agree with other comments about prominent leaders specializing in one subject to educate and inform. Instead of questioning the pro-life movement, strive to take steps to open up the conversation. Eve's Restoration Ministries was born out of the prolife movement. We are working to open a home for mothers whose children are in foster care, empowering them to rebuild and reunite their families. Caring for mothers & children who have already been born has always been a talking point. We just need more hands and feet in this area. ♥️- Amanda Douglas Founder & President

It’s absolutely heartbreaking. And then we have to start asking about the lives of women too… and everyone who’s ashamed because of the way the Church has misused the medical term “abortion”, while women in our pews know that’s what is listed on our medical payers from the removal of a pregnancy where a heart has stopped beating, or is missing organs, or has a brain growing outside the body, all of which we’re a risk to our lives….God forgive us for the way we have treated each other based on what Jerry Fowell told us, and not on what Jesus did. 😢
